patch_description: Enable per-block rotation specialization by giving each block its own shared RY/RZ pair ("ry_1"/"rz_1" for block 1, "ry_2"/"rz_2" for block 2). This maintains parameter economy (4 total params, one per gate type per block) while allowing each layer to learn distinct rotation landscapes independently. The high gate-to-parameter ratio (~93 gates per param) is preserved, and per-block specialization should improve expressiveness and potentially accelerate convergence by allowing each layer to adapt to different feature spaces. The fixed CZ chain structure maintains connectivity while parameter specialization enables richer feature learning.
